query:
UPDATE import_entity
            SET metadata = jsonb_set(
                    metadata #- '{plan,alreadyImported}' #- '{plan,reason}',
                    '{plan,shared}', to_jsonb($3::bool)
                ), updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE user_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND status = 'importing'
              AND metadata->'plan' IS NOT NULL
